description: This PHP class 'ImportStorageTransformer' is part of Drupal's configuration management system. It handles transforming storage during configuration import, managing locks, dispatching events, and interacting with the database to prepare configuration data for import.

classes.name: ImportStorageTransformer
classes.description: Final class responsible for transforming configuration storage during import, managing locks, and dispatching transformation events within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event dispatcher, database connection, request lock, and persistent lock.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the given storage for import, managing locks, copying data to a mutable storage, and dispatching an event for further modifications.
